1.text: Mwa bakiranutsi mwe,Mwishimire Uwiteka,Gushima gukwiriye abatunganye.

2.text: Mushimishe Uwiteka inanga,Mumuririmbirire ishimwe kuri nebelu y'imirya cumi.

3.text: Mumuririmbire indirimbo nshya,Mucurangishe inanga ubwenge,Muyivugishe ijwi rirenga.

4.text: Kuko ijambo ry'Uwiteka ritunganye,Imirimo ye yose ayikorana umurava.

5.text: Akunda gukiranuka n'imanza zitabera,Isi yuzuye imbabazi z'Uwiteka.

6.text: Ijambo ry'Uwiteka ni ryo ryaremye ijuru,Umwuka wo mu kanwa ke ni wo waremye ingabo zo muri ryo zose.

7.text: Ateranya amazi yo mu nyanja nk'ikirundo,Ashyingura imuhengeri mu bubiko.

8.text: Isi yose yubahe Uwiteka,Abari mu isi bose bamutinye.

10.text: Uwiteka ahindura ubusa imigambi y'amahanga,Akuraho ibyo amoko yibwira.

11.text: Imigambi y'Uwiteka ikomera iteka ryose,Ibyo yibwira mu mutima we bihoraho ibihe byose.

12.text: Hahirwa ishyanga rifite Uwiteka ho Imana yaryo,Ubwoko yitoranirije kuba umwandu we.

13.text: Uwiteka arebera mu ijuru,Areba abana b'abantu bose.

14.text: Ari mu buturo bwe,Areba ababa mu isi bose.

15.text: Ni we ubumba imitima yabo bose,Akitegereza imirimo yabo yose.

16.text: Nta mwami ukizwa n'uko ingabo ze ari nyinshi,Intwari ntikizwa n'imbaraga zayo nyinshi.

17.text: Ifarashi nta mumaro igira wo gukiza,Ntizakirisha umuntu imbaraga zayo nyinshi.

18.text: Dore ijisho ry'Uwiteka riri ku bamwubaha,Riri ku bategereza imbabazi ze,

19.text: Ngo akize ubugingo bwabo urupfu,Abarinde mu nzara badapfa.

20.text: Imitima yacu itegereza Uwiteka,Ni we mutabazi wacu n'ingabo idukingira.

21.text: Imitima yacu izamwishimira,Kuko twiringiye izina rye ryera.

22.text: Uwiteka, imbabazi zawe zibe kuri tweNk'uko tugutegereza.
